description: This file defines the SNKeyRecoveryService class, which manages key recovery operations, including handling undecryptable item keys, performing server sign-in, managing a decryption queue, and coordinating key recovery workflows within a secure data synchronization system.

classes.name: SNKeyRecoveryService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing key recovery processes, including handling undecryptable keys, coordinating server sign-in, managing a decryption queue, and emitting events related to key recovery.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up references and removes observers when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Handles application stage changes, triggering processing of persisted undecryptables when the database is loaded.

methods.name: handleIgnoredItemsKeys
methods.description: Processes items keys that arrived from remote sources but could not be decrypted, optionally persisting them.

methods.name: handleUndecryptableItemsKeys
methods.description: Handles items keys that are undecryptable, adding them to the recovery queue.

methods.name: presentKeyRecoveryWizard
methods.description: Displays the key recovery wizard for invalid item keys.

methods.name: canAttemptDecryptionOfItem
methods.description: Checks if an item can be attempted for decryption, returning an error or true.

methods.name: processPersistedUndecryptables
methods.description: Processes and attempts to decrypt any stored undecryptable items keys.

methods.name: getUndecryptables
methods.description: Retrieves stored undecryptable items keys from local storage.

methods.name: persistUndecryptables
methods.description: Saves the undecryptable items keys to local storage.

methods.name: saveToUndecryptables
methods.description: Adds new keys to the undecryptables storage.

methods.name: removeFromUndecryptables
methods.description: Removes specified keys from the undecryptables storage.

methods.name: getClientKeyParams
methods.description: Retrieves client account key parameters from the protocol service.

methods.name: performServerSignIn
methods.description: Performs a server sign-in process involving challenge-response to obtain the root key.

methods.name: getWrappingKeyIfApplicable
methods.description: Retrieves a wrapping key if passcode protection is enabled.

methods.name: addKeysToQueue
methods.description: Adds keys to the decryption queue for processing.

methods.name: readdQueueItem
methods.description: Re-inserts a queue item at the start of the decryption queue.

methods.name: getLatestKeyParamsFromServer
methods.description: Fetches latest account key parameters from the server.

methods.name: beginKeyRecovery
methods.description: Initiates the key recovery process, including sign-in if necessary, and processes the queue.

methods.name: potentiallyPerformFallbackSignInToUpdateOutdatedLocalRootKey
methods.description: Performs fallback sign-in if local key parameters are outdated compared to server.

methods.name: processQueue
methods.description: Processes the decryption queue, handling each item sequentially.

methods.name: processQueueItem
methods.description: Processes an individual queue item, running key recovery operations.

methods.name: handleDecryptionOfAllKeysMatchingCorrectRootKey
methods.description: Handles decryption of all keys matching a specific root key, updating the protocol and emitting events.

methods.name: removeElementsFromQueueForMatchingKeyParams
methods.description: Removes queue items matching specific key parameters.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Returns diagnostic information about the current state of the key recovery service.
